branch_theorem.boundary_terms: each axis subtraction has at most a simple O(epsilon^-1) pole, so even coincident axis/boundary poles vanish as O(epsilon^(1/2)) after normalization
branch_theorem.double_boundary_control: coincident horizontal and vertical boundary poles are a sum of simple poles, never a second-order pole
branch_theorem.negative_time: the limit at -2*sqrt(E) is the complex conjugate
branch_theorem.nonmatching_shells: finitely many nonmatching denominators stay bounded and vanish after epsilon^(3/2)
branch_theorem.uniform_tail: outside a fixed radius, m^2+alpha^2*n^2>=min(1,alpha^2)*(m^2+n^2) gives an epsilon-uniform summable |(m,n)|^-3 majorant

collision_theorem.classification: for distinct absolute representatives with n^2!=n'^2, collision iff beta=(m'^2-m^2)/(n^2-n'^2)>0
collision_theorem.irrational_branch: irrational beta has no collision beyond coordinate signs
collision_theorem.multiple_collision_slopes: distinct absolute representatives in one collision fibre have distinct n^2 slopes
collision_theorem.rational_branch: for beta=u/v in lowest terms, complete shells are exactly fibres v*m^2+u*n^2=N

irrational_quadratic_field.comparison_rule: equality of m^2+sqrt(2)*n^2 is coefficientwise over Q(sqrt(2))

hard_gate.advance_over_c162: the square coefficient becomes an all-alpha coefficient with an exact rational collision locus and pairwise-transverse branch splitting
hard_gate.required: an all-aspect trace identity plus a proved deformation law for complete shell coefficients

poisson_identity.square_recovery: alpha=1 gives the C157 square identity exactly

quantization.same_clock: the half-wave boundary time is unchanged

source_lock.clock: half-wave boundary time t under s=epsilon-i*t
source_lock.determinant_convention: none; clean lattice shells are not isolated-orbit determinants
source_lock.forbidden_data: target zero/prime tables, target divisor/counting law, arithmetic local or Euler factors, root numbers, automorphy, Hilbert--Polya, Route B
source_lock.object: Dirichlet Abel half-wave trace on Q_alpha=(0,1)x(0,alpha), alpha>0
source_lock.precision: exact integer/quadratic-field collision arithmetic and 80-decimal branch sentinels
